title: Study on the impact of two medical treatments and a surgical procedure on the prevention of a heart rhythm disorder after cardiac surgery (PREV-AF)
official: Multicenter and randomised study on atrial fibrillation prevention after cardiac surgery with a 3-way comparison between standard of care, posterior pericardiotomy and a treatment bundle (colchicine, amiodarone and posterior pericardiotomy) (PREV-AF)
summary: Main objective: Efficacy to decrease the incidence of atrial fibrillation during the postoperative follow-up hospitalization after cardiac surgery, of the preventive treatment bundle (associating colchicine, amiodarone, and posterior pericardial window) compared to the standard of care, as well as the posterior pericardial window alone compared to the standard of care.

interventions.name: BISOPROLOL BGR 5 mg, comprimé pelliculé sécable
HEPARIN GALENIKA 5000 UI/ml solution for injection

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patient (≥ 18 years old) hospitalized for aortic, coronary, ascending aortic, or combined valvular heart surgery
2. Patient understands French
3. Patient affiliated with the French Social Security
4. Patient has given a written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient who are part of a vulnerable population (including pregnant women and patients under guardianship or trusteeship)
2. Patient presenting a contraindication to colchicine
3. Patient who refuses access to his/her personal data for quality control
4. Patient treated with immunosuppressive therapy (for example cyclosporine)
5. Women of childbearing potential who are sexually active in a heterosexual relationship and not using a highly effective method of contraception
6. Patient presenting a contraindication to amiodarone
7. Current treatment by amiodarone or colchicine
8. Patient who will receive emergency surgery (< 24h)
9. Patient who will receive mitral or tricuspid valve surgery
10. Patient who will receive Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI)
11. Patient with active sepsis (endocarditis)
12. Patient with a history of atrial fibrillation
13. Patient presenting a contraindication to the posterior pericardial window
